text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that parking be prohibited from December 1 to March 31 of the following year, on the east side of Hamlet Gate, between Bamboo Grove and Denlow Boulevard. Currently parking is allowed for up to three hours on both sides of the street. The proposed changes will address residents' concerns with parked vehicles and plowed snow obstructing traffic.
North York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking from December 1 to March 31 of the following year, inclusive, on the east side of Hamlet Gate, between Bamboo Grove and Denlow Boulevard.
